candidates.change_summary: Change returned AssertionPolicy to block assertions (set blockAssertion to true) instead of false.
Change returned AssertionPolicy to require arbitration via escalation manager (set arbitrateViaEscalationManager to true).
Change returned AssertionPolicy to instruct discarding oracle (set discardOracle to true).
Change returned AssertionPolicy to require validation of disputer (set validateDisputers to true).
Negate all boolean fields (flip each boolean to its opposite) in returned AssertionPolicy.
Change the function to always return false instead of true.
Change the function to return true only when disputeCaller equals the zero address; otherwise return false.
Change the function to return true only when the assertionId equals bytes32(0); otherwise return false.
Negate the original result by returning !true (i.e., false) but written as an expression using the original literal.
Changed getPrice from an empty body to return a constant positive price of 1 (int256 1).
Changed getPrice from an empty body to return a constant negative price of -1 (int256 -1).
Changed getPrice to return the provided time cast to int256.
Changed getPrice to return the hash of identifier truncated to int256 (int256(uint256(identifier))).
Removed the onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier so requestPrice can be called by any caller and still emits PriceRequestAdded.
Added a require that only the contract itself can call requestPrice, preventing external callers and changing whether PriceRequestAdded can be emitted by callers.
Invert the access check so requestPrice and other onlyOptimisticAsserter-protected functions are callable by anyone except the optimistic asserter, changing whether requests proceed.
Make assertionResolvedCallback set a public-accessible state by emitting an event containing assertedTruthfully, thus altering observable state after the call.
Make assertionResolvedCallback revert when assertedTruthfully is false, changing observable completion behavior.
Change onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier to require sender is NOT the optimistic asserter, altering which callers can invoke assertionResolvedCallback.
